Siri AI is a major upgrade and highlight of iOS 27 and above. However, only newer Apple device models support the revamped Siri. Below is the full list of devices supporting Siri AI, covering iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Below are the Apple products that support Siri AI features in iOS 27 and above

iOS 27 and its companion updates have finally brought the long-awaited major Siri overhaul, named Siri AI.

Siri AI is only available on compatible hardware (and in select regions). Below is a list of every Apple product that supports Siri AI.

iPhone

  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 17
  • iPhone 17e
  • iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 and 16 Plus
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max

iPad

  • iPad Pro (M1 chip and newer)
  • iPad Air (M1 chip and newer)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)

Mac

  • All models with Apple silicon (M1 chip and newer, as well as A18 Pro chip)

Apple Watch (must be paired with an AI-capable iPhone)

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and newer
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and newer
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Vision Pro

  • All models

All of the products above support Siri AI. However, some features of the Siri experience will perform better on certain hardware.

For example, the ability to fully customize Siri AI's voice pacing and emotional expression is only available on select hardware. Apple stated:

The reason for this limitation is that Apple's most powerful on-device AI models only work on newer products. Users with these models may or may not experience faster performance when using Siri AI.

Does Siri AI make you want to upgrade your Apple hardware? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
